queries.sql: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('historical_result_matches','historical_result_versions','sports_archive_imports','temporal_receipts','raw_snapshots') ORDER BY name
SELECT provider,COUNT(*) AS import_versions,SUM(record_count) AS records, MIN(fetched_at) AS first_receipt,MAX(fetched_at) AS last_receipt FROM sports_archive_imports GROUP BY provider
SELECT namespace,COUNT(*) AS receipt_rows,MIN(available_at) AS first_available,MAX(available_at) AS last_available FROM temporal_receipts GROUP BY namespace
SELECT provider,COUNT(*) AS provider_native_ids FROM historical_result_matches GROUP BY provider

SELECT v.*,m.provider,m.provider_id,
            EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM temporal_receipts t WHERE t.namespace='result'
                   AND t.source_key=v.version_id) AS has_any_result_receipt
            FROM historical_result_versions v JOIN historical_result_matches m USING(match_id)
            ORDER BY v.match_id,v.observed_at DESC,v.version_id

interpretation: Provider IDs and versions are not cross-provider deduplicated unique games.
Downloaded outcomes are not proof of historical pre-match feature availability.
Canonical result receipt absence blocks the weather reference reader; raw numeric model view has separate raw/HTTP witnesses.
Physical raw payload hashes, all-league completeness and general model eligibility NOT certified by metadata counts.
The original 2.2 five-year requirement remains RED_PARTIAL; current original215 remains 176GREEN39RED.
Remaining query windows are NOT an exact count of future HTTP requests or a completion-time promise.

independent_readback.query:
SELECT m.provider,COUNT(*) AS versions,COUNT(DISTINCT v.match_id) AS ids,
            MIN(json_extract(record_json,'$.match_date')) AS first_match,
            MAX(json_extract(record_json,'$.match_date')) AS last_match,
            SUM(json_extract(record_json,'$.kickoff') IS NULL) AS unknown_utc_versions,
            SUM(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temporal_receipts t WHERE t.namespace='result'
                AND t.source_key=v.version_id)) AS missing_result_receipt_versions
            FROM historical_result_versions v JOIN historical_result_matches m USING(match_id)
            GROUP BY m.provider
